selection_basis: Official 3B model fits available CPU memory. Generic runtime smoke preceded this freeze. No benchmark QA responses inspected.
thread_selection: Eight threads matches the generic smoke and prior pass. No change based on benchmark outputs.
failure_policy: Complete JSON object or one complete JSON code fence only. Non-stop finish, narrative, invalid types, or invalid citations yield empty predicted answers and retain the question denominator.
amendment_reason: Pre-output resource amendment after the first8192-context request remained incomplete for over seven minutes. Cgroup memory limit is8GiB. No completed QA response was produced or inspected. Reduce KV context to4096 and prompt batch/ubatch to128/64. Exact model, quantization, prompt strings, seed, temperature, output-token limit, parser, and all QA memberships remain unchanged.
token_fit_policy: Before any generation, apply the model chat template and tokenizer to every primary and diagnostic prompt. Require input tokens plus96 output tokens plus16 margin tokens to fit4096.
